title: Fixed vocabulary
note: The only words and colours the dashboard is allowed to use for direction, tone, cycle stage and where a fact came from. Every colour here was checked with a colour-blindness and contrast validator against a white background. Every item carries a plainLabel so no visitor has to know finance words.

trajectoryFlags.label: Accelerating
trajectoryFlags.meaning: Growing, and growing faster than last quarter.

trajectoryFlags.label: Steady
trajectoryFlags.meaning: Moving along at about the same pace.

trajectoryFlags.label: Decelerating
trajectoryFlags.meaning: Still growing, but slower than last quarter.

trajectoryFlags.label: Inflecting Up
trajectoryFlags.meaning: Was falling, has just started to rise.

trajectoryFlags.label: Inflecting Down
trajectoryFlags.meaning: Was rising, has just started to fall.

steps.label: Confident
steps.meaning: Sure of themselves. Talks about growth and new spending.

steps.label: Neutral
steps.meaning: Neither good nor bad. Wait and see.

steps.label: Cautious
steps.meaning: Holding back. Talks about risks and delays.

steps.label: Defensive
steps.meaning: Protecting the business. Talks about cutting costs.

cycleStages.label: Trough
cycleStages.meaning: Spending is at its lowest. Nothing is being ordered.

cycleStages.label: Early Upcycle
cycleStages.meaning: First new orders are landing. Only the early movers feel it.

cycleStages.label: Mid Upcycle
cycleStages.meaning: Orders are broad. Most of the sector is busy.

cycleStages.label: Late Upcycle/Peak
cycleStages.meaning: Everyone is at full stretch. Costs are climbing.

cycleStages.label: Early Downcycle
cycleStages.meaning: New orders are thinning out. The early movers slow first.

sourceTags.label: Official
sourceTags.meaning: Published by a government body or regulator.

sourceTags.label: Company Filing
sourceTags.meaning: Taken straight from a company's own filed results.

sourceTags.label: Mgmt Claim
sourceTags.meaning: Something management stated but nobody has checked.

sourceTags.label: External
sourceTags.meaning: From a news report, broker note or industry body.

sourceTags.label: Estimate
sourceTags.meaning: A forward guess, not a reported number.

sourceTags.label: Inference
sourceTags.meaning: A conclusion drawn from what was said, not stated outright.

sourceTags.label: Derived
sourceTags.meaning: Calculated by this dashboard from other data on this page.

sourceTags.label: Unknown
sourceTags.meaning: We do not know where this came from. Treat with care.

standingSix.plainDescription: Six slots that get read every quarter no matter what, because between them they cover the whole chain from drilling to fuel pumps.

slots.label: ONGC
slots.why: The biggest spender. If it stops ordering, the cycle stops.

slots.label: Deep Industries / Jindal Drilling
slots.why: The rigs get hired first. The earliest hard signal there is.

slots.label: Reliance
slots.why: Sets the tone for refining and petrochemicals.

slots.label: Engineers India
slots.why: Its order book is a preview of the next few years of projects.

slots.label: Petronet LNG
slots.why: Shows how much imported gas the country is actually using.

slots.label: IOCL / BPCL
slots.why: Fuel demand at the pump, plus the biggest refinery spending plans.
